business_summary.text: HMA Agro Industries is an integrated Indian food processing and export company, a Five Star Export House selling halal frozen buffalo meat, seafood, rice, pet food and allied agro products to more than 40 countries under brands including Black Gold, Kamil and Darlingpets.

call_points.text: Consolidated EBITDA margin improved to about 4.11% from about 3.57% last year.
Livestock procurement costs depend on weather and farmer pricing; the company said it cannot manage this strongly.
The Philippines target was not achieved last year; the market buys only a few product varieties and the company is working to widen demand.
Rice exports are growing slowly but steadily with repeat orders; the rice share of FY26 revenue was not available.
No numeric FY27 guidance; management only says it is confident about long-term growth prospects.
FY26 export quantity rose to 2,21,187 MT from 1,99,549 MT in FY25.
Future roadmap lists capacity expansion, new market entry and value-added products, without amounts or dates.
Management names export regulations, currency volatility, supply chain disruption and livestock availability as key risks.

industry: Fast Moving Consumer Goods > Food Products > Meat Products including Poultry

operating_notes.text: Divested 100% stake in FNS Agro Foods Limited and Laal Agro Foods Private Limited.
Promoter and promoter group held 40,87,58,500 shares of HMA Agro as on 31 March 2026, with no encumbrance during FY26 (Reg 31(4) declaration).
FY26 export quantity 2,21,187 MT vs 1,99,549 MT in FY25.
Daily processing capacity ~1,472 MT across 8+ facilities; six integrated plants with aggregate annual capacity of about four lakh tonnes.
Presence in 40+ countries, strong in Middle East, Africa and Asia, expanding in Europe and Latin America.
65,375 shareholders on the postal ballot record date; 33.79 Cr shares (67.468% of 50,07,69,770) polled.
FY26 consolidated EBITDA margin about 4.11% versus about 3.57% last year.
Philippines target for FY26 was not achieved; the market buys only selected product varieties.
French fries and chicken are at a very initial stage with no volumes or numbers disclosed.
Mr. Wajid Ahmed, an outgoing promoter-group member, holds nil equity shares and has no management, board or KMP role in the company.

timeline.summary: HMA Agro board approved Gulzar Ahmad's re-appointment as CMD, the divestment of two subsidiaries, and shifting its registered office to Delhi.
2026-05-21: Promoter MD Mohammad Mehmood Qureshi declared under Reg 31(4) that the promoter group held 40,87,58,500 HMA Agro shares as on 31 March 2026 with no encumbrance during FY26.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,579.1 Cr (+5.3% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹7.96 Cr (-39.8% YoY).
2026-05-26: HMA Agro's Q4/FY26 investor presentation showed FY26 consolidated revenue up 34.75% to ₹6,916.50 Cr and PAT up 88.37%, but Q4 EBITDA fell 19.41% and PAT 33.43%.
On May 29, 2026, HMA Agro Industries submitted the proceedings and voting details of its postal ballot held on May 28, 2026.

2026-05-29: HMA Agro shareholders passed all eight postal ballot resolutions — Gulzar Ahmad as Chairperson & MD, two new whole-time directors, Luthra's re-appointment as independent director, Articles alteration and the registered office shift to Delhi.
HMA Agro Industries Limited uploaded audio recording of its May 29, 2026, analyst/investor conference call on Q4 & FY2025-26 results via its website.

2026-06-02: HMA Agro filed the transcript of its May 29, 2026 Q4/FY26 earnings call, where management reaffirmed the ₹10,000 Cr FY27 revenue goal without numeric guidance and flagged freight and livestock costs.
On June 03, 2026, HMA Agro Industries announced the resignation of Managing Director Mohammad Mehmood Qureshi and the retirement of Whole-Time Director & CEO Gulzeb Ahmed effective June 02, 2026.

On 15 October 2026, HMA Agro's board approved reclassifying Mr. Wajid Ahmed, who holds nil shares, from the Promoter & Promoter Group category to Public, subject to stock exchange approval, following a family settlement dated 20 September 2026.
